title: Mid-thoracic axial rotation range from neutral, flexed and extended sitting postures, by sex
condition: healthy, seated with pelvis belted, maximal active axial rotation initiated from neutral, end-range thoracic flexion or extension

quantity.name: axial rotation range
quantity.definition: maximal axial rotation of the mid-thoracic (T6/rib-6) marker segment relative to the laboratory, pelvis fixed

source.authors: Edmondston SJ, Aggerholm M, Elfving S, Flores N, Ng C, Smith R, Netto K
source.sample: 52 asymptomatic adults, BMI <= 28, no spinal trauma/surgery/deformity or current thoracic pain

protocol.summary: Thoracic (thorax-on-pelvis) twist range in sitting; ~41 deg each side from neutral, falls ~20% (to ~32-34 deg) when started from flexed posture.
how_to_use: Use ~40-42 deg per side as maximal seated thorax-on-pelvis axial rotation for a young adult (male ~43, female ~38 deg from neutral).
Reduce the available twist by ~20% when the trunk is pre-flexed (31.8/33.5 deg); extension has no effect.
Distribute over thoracic levels with a regional source (e.g. Willems 1996 T4-T8 dominant).

measurement.device: PEAK Motus 4-camera optical system, 50 Hz; markers over T6 transverse processes and rib-6 costochondral junctions (mid-thoracic 'thorax' segment vs laboratory)
measurement.posture: seated on stool, pelvis and thigh belted, arms abducted 90 deg with hands on shoulders
measurement.task: maximal active axial rotation to left and right from neutral, end-range thoracic flexion, and end-range thoracic extension postures

extraction.uncertainty: as printed (0.1 deg); within-session repeatability 2.9 deg rotation, 1.1 deg coupled LF
extraction.check_notes: Re-read from 250 dpi page images; pdftotext dropped minus signs on range lower bounds of coupled LF (restored from image). Some printed SD/range combinations look internally inconsistent (e.g. flexion-left 31.8 (SD 11.1, range 24.6-51.9); female 28.7 (SD 12.9, range 24.6-51.2)) but are kept as printed.

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
